END;

FUNCTION CHECK_DUPLICATE RETURN BOOLEAN IS

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF :pre_val is not null THEN
 IF :system.cursor_block = 'CTRL_BLK_2' THEN
 IF :pre_val = 'OK' THEN
 :rt_ok := :rt_ok - 1;
 ELSIF :pre_val = 'HOLD' THEN
 :rt_hold := :rt_hold - 1;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :system.cursor_block = 'CTRL_BLK_3' THEN
 IF :pre_val = 'NODEF' THEN
 :rt_nodef := :rt_nodef - 1;
 ELSIF :pre_val = 'PDEF' THEN
 :rt_pdef := :rt_pdef - 1;
 ELSIF :pre_val = 'TDEF' THEN
 :rt_tdef := :rt_tdef - 1;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
clear_record;

Trigger.Name: KEY-EXIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF get_block_property('CTRL_BLK_2',status) != 'NEW' 
 or get_block_property('CTRL_BLK_3',status) != 'NEW' 
THEN
 DECLARE
 ALERT_B number;
 BEGIN
 IF get_block_property('CTRL_BLK_2',status) != 'NEW' 
 THEN
 set_alert_property('EXIT_WARNING',alert_message_text, 
 'Audited data not saved !! ' || CHR(10) ||
 'OK Units - ' || to_char(nvl(:rt_ok,0)) || ' HOLD Units - ' || to_char(nvl(:rt_hold,0)) || CHR(10) ||
 'Do you want to save these audits ?');
 ELSIF get_block_property('CTRL_BLK_3',status) != 'NEW' 
 THEN
 set_alert_property('EXIT_WARNING',alert_message_text, 
 'Audited data not saved !! ' || CHR(10) ||
 'No Defs - ' || to_char(nvl(:rt_nodef,0)) || ' Temp Defs - ' || to_char(nvl(:rt_tdef,0))
 ||' Ind Defs - ' || to_char(nvl(:rt_pdef,0)) || CHR(10) ||
 'Do you want to save these audits ?');
 END IF;
 ALERT_B := show_alert('EXIT_WARNING');
 IF ALERT_B = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 do_commit_proc;
 :system.message_level := 5; 
 commit;
 IF not form_success THEN
 :system.message_level := 0; 
 show_error('0230');
 ELSE
 :system.message_level := 0; 
 show_error('8010');
 END IF;
 ELSIF ALERT_B = ALERT_BUTTON3 THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
END IF; 
exit_form(no_validate);

 ALERT_B number;
begin

 IF not form_success THEN

exception

end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 
 IF :GLOBAL.OPERATION_RTYPE='NA' THEN -- only for nursing adit (not for resetting) - added by Edwin 03-01-13 LT 2013
 IF :system.cursor_block = 'CTRL_BLK_1' THEN
 show_error('9162'); --No Changes to Commit;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 perform_validations;
 declare
 al_button number;
 begin
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY('CHOICE_ALERT', TITLE, '');
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY('CHOICE_ALERT', ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,
 'Confirm data entered is correct.');
 al_button := SHOW_ALERT('CHOICE_ALERT');
 IF al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN 
 do_commit_proc;
 IF :system.cursor_record != 1 THEN
 previous_record;
 next_record;
 END IF;
 :system.message_level := 5; 
 commit;
 IF not form_success THEN
 :system.message_level := 0; 
 show_error('0230');
 ELSE
 :system.message_level := 0; 
 show_error('8010');
 clear_form(no_validate);
 initialise_windows;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 exception
 WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 end;
 END IF; 
 ELSE
 null;
 END IF; 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
END;
